span_resolution_rule: Reviewers select source_span_text; offsets are derived and are never human input.
boundary_reference_rule: target_value_span_ids must come from the row's deterministic L1 span list
field_gold_rule: Every human-routed KOSIS_CANDIDATE value must be linked to exactly one human indicator scope and have measurement_gold plus period_gold; the explicit period answer 없음 is valid.
reference_integrity_rule: dominant and inherited IDs must be defined in the same article
disagreement_rule: No row is auto-confirmed in the full review artifact
measurement_note: The roadmap said 255 sentences; the current frozen dev input and current sentence splitter produce 256. No sentence is dropped to fit the stale count.
